fields.stage: Phase 1/1b 28-day multiple-dose sponsor results; Phase 2 planned
fields.summary: An investigational daily oral tablet intended to create a transient lining in the small intestine and alter nutrient absorption. On 15 September 2026 Syntis reported observations from the randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled 28-day multiple-ascending-dose portion in 23 adults with overweight or obesity. The company reported greater weight loss than placebo in each dose cohort and changes in satiety-related hormones; a Phase 2 study was planned for 2027, not treated as started.
fields.limitations: Small, early sponsor-reported study. Detailed results were still due for presentation in November 2026 and were not independently reviewed here. The announcement does not provide complete cohort-level weight-loss estimates in its text. Preclinical lean-muscle findings are not human evidence, and the study does not establish long-term benefit, comparative efficacy, UK authorisation, NHS access or supply.
